reviews.text: My wife and I recently commissioned Ernesto at Rockwall Contractors to build a patio deck for us. We are very pleased with the results! The personal touches the Ernesto provided exceeded our expectations. He came by times daily to insure it was meeting HIS expectations as well. We are very pleased and thankful for the timeliness and quality of the work! We highly recommend him to anyone who is considering home improvement projects. Lupe & Diane Gonzales
reviews.author: Lupe Gonzales (LupeG71)

reviews.text: Ernesto and his team did a phenomenal job at remodeling our master bathroom from demo to redoing our floor and shower tile, installing all new fixtures, sinks, etc. They were reasonably priced, performed excellent craftsmanship, and were finished on time. Communication was wonderful, and we will use them in the future for more projects.
reviews.author: Emily Mackie

reviews.text: Ernesto and his sub-contractors are great. Their work is excellent and their attention to details is the best I've experience in home remodel. They have exceeded my expectations and provided a beautiful update to our home.
reviews.author: Bob Thorman

reviews.text:
I can't say enough great things about Rockwall Contractors! I hired them for a variety of projects, including repairing my iron gates, resurfacing and coating my pool concrete deck, and replacing the coping, as well as putting in crown molding with backlighting remote controlled color changing LED  lights. Additionally, they poured a beautiful concrete walkway in my backyard.
The entire experience was outstanding. Not only was the work completed beautifully, but it was also done within budget and on time. That kind of reliability and professionalism is hard to come by in the construction industry, and Rockwall Contractors delivered on all fronts.
The crew they sent to work on my projects was not only skilled but also incredibly responsive and punctual. I couldn't be happier with the results.
If you're in need of a general contractor who will not only meet but exceed your expectations, I wholeheartedly recommend Rockwall Contractors. They are professional, reliable, and their work is nothing short of exceptional. I'm thrilled with the results, and I'm sure you will be too!
reviews.author: FiveOFour Concepts

reviews.text: We had a great experience working with Ernesto and his team at Rockwall Contractors for our pool resurfacing project. From start to finish, Ernesto was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly responsive. He took the time to explain the process thoroughly and answered all of our questions patiently.The quality of workmanship was outstanding. Our pool looks brand new again, and the attention to detail is evident in every aspect of the resurfacing. They completed the project within the estimated timeframe and budget, which was greatly appreciated. Ernesto and his crew were also respectful of our property and ensured everything was clean and tidy after each workday. We couldn't be happier with the results. If you're looking for a reliable contractor who delivers top-notch quality, look no further than Rockwall Contractors. We highly recommend them for any pool or construction project.
reviews.author: Dineta Cooper

reviews.text: Ernesto and team are awesome to work with.Always on time , prepared and on budget. The Rockwall team are professional craftsmen that do the job right. High quality at the right price.
reviews.author: jason rice

reviews.text: Earnesto and his crew knocked it out of the park when they tuckpointed our exisitng masonary gate-wall. It looks brand new and Rockwall Contractors was very comeptitively priced. He came and looked at the job, gave me a price, and a few days later it was completed. Earnesto is professional, friendly, and surpassed my expectations!
reviews.author: Robert Dougherty

reviews.text: Rockwall Contractors completely refurbished our 30-year-old pool and concrete deck.We cannot be happier with the results. The workmen were both efficient and excellent craftsmen. Ernesto kept us up to date and was quick and helpful in answering our many questions. We give Rockwall Contractors the highest possible ratings for their work and professionalism.
reviews.author: Pam Goldthwaite
